title: Willie Campbell Dies
text:
Willie Campbell Dies

SAVOY.—Funeral service will be held Thursday at 3 p.m. in the Savoy Church of Christ for Willie James Campbell, 68, Negro of Savoy. He died Monday in his home in Savoy after an illness of one year.

O. A. Ross, minister of the Church of Christ, will officiate. Burial will be in Savoy Cemetery, directed by Grayson Funeral Home.

Survivors are two daughters, one son and two grandchildren.
